classification: Strict independent IL composite build for one reviewed proposal. The extension header/body and one same-size caller token were compiled in memory and the active integrity fields were regenerated. No ROM was booted, no MAME run was made and no hardware compatibility is claimed.

buildResult.unrepairedComposition: 14 realized extension changes plus 2 caller-token bytes; 1014 and 101A remain FF

integrity.algorithmOrder: sum_xor (FFD1/FFD2) -> rotate_add (FFD3) -> rotate_sub_xor (FFD4/FFD5); each phase reads the fields written by the preceding phase
integrity.boundedInputs: Exact 1010-101F 16-byte FF allocation with the reviewed 00F8 plus certified body, and the single 9F14 9ED7 -> 1010 two-byte caller replacement.
integrity.fixed9ED9ApiPreserved: VmIlIntegrity.Repair and the fixed 9EDC edit regressions are unchanged.

ownershipRepair.defect: CompositeWordSourceMap.Nodes, Entries and Phases returned copied arrays as IReadOnlyList, so callers could cast back to IList<T> or T[] and replace elements after build validation. CompositeWordBuildResult.IntegrityReport also exposed the mutable array-backed VmIlIntegrityReport fields and lists.
ownershipRepair.repair: Source-map node/entry/phase arrays are cloned into ReadOnlyCollection<T> wrappers. The composite build snapshots its integrity report privately and returns a fresh defensive copy of the Fields list plus the UnrepairedChangedOffsets, RepairedChangedOffsets and RepairChangedOffsets arrays on every access.
ownershipRepair.mutationChecks: The IL verifier casts source-map collections to IList<T>, attempts set/add/remove/clear, attempts array-cast exposure, mutates returned integrity report arrays and field list, then rechecks map resolution, serialized map, retained report, final output fields, hashes and changed count.

ilVerifier.compositeMutationGroup: Read-only map and integrity report reject external mutation
ilVerifier.comparison: Curated contract parsing plus independent diff, count, SHA1/SHA256 and ordered-checksum verification, with caller mutation attempts against the read-only map collections and defensively copied integrity report.

limitations: The 1010 composite word and the 9F14 redirect are statically compiled only.
No natural reach of 1010, runtime handler observation, MAME boot or hardware test was performed in this slice.
The body is a byte-identical copy of the certified 9ED9 token sequence; no general dictionary/header decoding, relocation or banking is claimed.
The broader purpose of the 9F12 caller remains unresolved.
Integrity repair is algorithmically verified, not natural boot acceptance.
nextBoundary: After review, run a natural fresh-boot MAME task with the imgui/BGFX paused debugger using the final-ROM-bound composite map. Observe the 1010 header/body, native handlers, return through 7931 and the saved cursor 9F16. No execution proof exists here.
